size_estimate.spread_warning: bytes per live chapter ranges from 0.01 MB to 6.88 MB across measured titles, so the projection is an order-of-magnitude figure, not a budget
size_estimate.extracted_text_expectation: Only extracted text and a SHA-256 per source PDF get committed, so the tracked cost is roughly 3-8% of the PDF bytes. The PDF bytes are the download cost, not the repository cost.
